headline: Experts advise focusing on fundamentals as recent IPO stocks correct from listing highs
hook: Post-listing correction tests recent IPO stock prices
summary: Recent data on 10 newly listed IPOs shows a wide gap between their initial listing prices and current returns. While all 10 stocks have corrected from their listing highs, seven of them still trade above their original issue prices. Financial experts note that heavy listing gains often reflect short-term demand rather than long-term value. Investors are urged to prioritize company earnings, cash flows, and valuations over listing-day pop when evaluating primary market issues.
why_it_matters: Listing day pops do not guarantee long-term IPO returns.

headline: Premier Energies bags Rs 4,001 crore orders in Q2 for solar cell and module supplies
hook: Strong order intake drives Q2 revenue visibility
summary: Premier Energies secured orders worth Rs 4,001 crore in the second quarter for 2,308 MW of solar cell and module supplies, alongside EPC project execution. The company reported a module manufacturing capacity of 11.1 GW and a solar cell capacity of 10.6 GW. This substantial order book expansion enhances revenue visibility for the renewable energy manufacturer. For Indian retail investors, large order wins highlight strong sectoral tailwinds in domestic solar manufacturing.
why_it_matters: Order wins boost revenue visibility for domestic solar manufacturer.

headline: Brokerage backs NTPC and CESC while flagging margin pressure on solar manufacturers
hook: Conventional generators favoured as solar margins squeeze
summary: Elara Capital highlighted NTPC, NLC India, and CESC as top picks following an 11.2% year-on-year increase in national power generation to 536 billion units during the second quarter. In contrast, the brokerage warned of impending margin compression for solar module players including Waaree Energies, Premier Energies, Vikram Solar, and Emmvee. Generation remained robust through the quarter, rising 10.58% in July, 11.8% in August, and 11.2% in September.
whats_next: Upcoming quarterly corporate earnings will confirm extent of solar margin pressure.
why_it_matters: Power generators gain demand support while solar equipment makers face profitability headwinds.
winners_losers: Power generators gain / solar manufacturers hurt
